bracket_wording.exact_clause: If both release criteria pass, the two checks bracket the load transition within 0.500-0.502 s; they corroborate (do not independently establish) the prescribed 0.501 s release completion. If either fails, the outcome is INCONCLUSIVE.

detail_1_bin_spacing.exact_clause: The raw (unpadded) spectral bin spacing is df_raw = f_s / N, where f_s is the measured sampling rate in samples/s and N is the number of unpadded time-domain samples in the measurement window. The adequacy bound is df_raw <= 0.5 Hz. f_s is obtained from output timestamps as 1 / median(inter-sample interval) over the measurement window; N is the sample count. This replaces the v2 1/T_window formulation, which is ambiguous between N/f_s and (N-1)/f_s.

detail_2a_tolerance_A.exact_clause: J_applied over window A = [0.498, 0.500] s must satisfy |J_applied - (-1000 * dT_A)| <= 0.1 N-s, where dT_A = t_last_A - t_first_A is the actual endpoint-to-endpoint interval from output timestamps (nominal 0.002 s; nominal expectation -2.0 N-s). v2 stated the nominal -2.0 N-s; this freezes the symbolic form -1000*dT so the expectation tracks the actual sampled interval.

detail_2b_tolerance_B.exact_clause: J_applied over window B = [0.502, 0.504] s must satisfy |J_applied| <= 0.1 N-s, where J_applied[ta,tb] = [Pz(tb)-Pz(ta)] - [J_wall(tb)-J_wall(ta)] with (ta,tb) the actual first/last sample timestamps in the window.

detail_2c_endpoint_rule.exact_clause: Each release-check window must contain >= 3 output samples; the first/last samples used must lie within 0.25 ms of the stated window boundary, or the outcome is INCONCLUSIVE.
detail_2c_endpoint_rule.note: Retained verbatim from v2; restated here for completeness.

detail_3_sampling.exact_clause: Sampling cadence is f_s = 2000 samples/s nominal (/TFILE 0.0005 s), verified from output via the sampling-uniformity adequacy check. Requirement: f_s > 1200 samples/s, so the quiet-band upper limit (600 Hz) lies strictly below Nyquist (f_s/2). If measured f_s <= 1200 samples/s, the quiet-band SNR check is invalid and the outcome is INCONCLUSIVE.

estimator_accuracy_framing.exact_clause: 0.00184 Hz is the maximum observed error in the synthetic sweep: 1440 cases (3 interpolation quantities x 480 cases each, spanning fractional-bin offsets, phases, decay rates, noise and competing-mode levels, full and half windows) for the frozen configuration (log10-magnitude parabola, symmetric Hann, 8x zero-padding). It is an observed maximum over the tested conditions, not a proven bound for all possible signals.
